import re
hits = []
with open('/root/mobo_loop.log') as f:
    for line in f:
        m = re.search(r'\[(sobol|acq) (\d+)/\d+\]\s+DSI=([+-][\d.]+)\s+PD=\s*([\d.]+) Hz', line)
        if m:
            phase, idx, dsi, pd = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3)), float(m.group(4))
            if dsi >= 0.4 and pd >= 10.0:
                hits.append((phase, idx, dsi, pd))
print(f'{len(hits)} cells meet pass criterion (DSI>=0.4 AND PD>=10 Hz):')
for phase, idx, dsi, pd in hits:
    print(f'  [{phase} {idx}] DSI={dsi:+.3f}  PD={pd:6.2f} Hz')
"
